items.title: How Muse AI is expanding Meta's moat, & why you shouldn't bring iced coffee to job interviews
items.summary: In this episode of Market Hang, Turney Duff and his panel of experts weigh in on Meta's (META) Muse AI agent, how the bond market's recent moves could threaten the AI boom, job interview etiquette, and much more.Today's panel includes The Wall Street Skinny co-founders Kristen Kelly and Jen Saarbach, Business Insider Today executive editor Dan DeFrancesco, and "The Future of Wealth" author Armando Pantoja.
